mapper.insert: insert into batches (house_id, batch_code, status, start_date, end_date, request_id, remark, create_by, update_by) values (#{houseId}, #{batchCode}, #{status}, #{startDate}, #{endDate}, #{requestId}, #{remark}, #{createBy}, #{updateBy})
mapper.select: select id, house_id, batch_code, status, start_date, end_date, request_id, remark, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, (status != '已完成' and not exists (select 1 from batch_rabbits br where br.batch_id = batches.id and br.is_active = 1) ) as pending_completion from batches where house_id = #{houseId} and id = #{id}

select id, house_id, batch_code, status, start_date, end_date, request_id, remark, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, (status != '已完成' and not exists (select 1 from batch_rabbits br where br.batch_id = batches.id and br.is_active = 1) ) as pending_completion from batches where house_id = #{houseId} and id = #{id} for update

select id, house_id, batch_code, status, start_date, end_date, request_id, remark, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, (status != '已完成' and not exists (select 1 from batch_rabbits br where br.batch_id = batches.id and br.is_active = 1) ) as pending_completion from batches where house_id = #{houseId} order by id desc

select id, house_id, batch_code, status, start_date, end_date, request_id, remark, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, (status != '已完成' and not exists (select 1 from batch_rabbits br where br.batch_id = batches.id and br.is_active = 1) ) as pending_completion from batches where house_id = #{houseId} and request_id = #{requestId} limit 1
mapper.update: update batches set status = #{status}, start_date = #{startDate}, end_date = #{endDate}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = now() where house_id = #{houseId} and id = #{id}
update batches set batch_code = #{batchCode}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = now() where house_id = #{houseId} and id = #{id}
